concept: CloudTrail: API call auditing with long-term retention in S3 + Glacier
tests: Which services give a complete log of API calls (who, when, from where) with cheap multi-year retention.
expected: CloudTrail trail → S3 bucket + S3 lifecycle policy → Glacier for older logs. Triggers: "every API call", "identity, time, source IP", "retained for several years", "cost-effectively".
why_not: VPC Flow Logs — network traffic, not API calls; CloudWatch detailed monitoring — metrics; DynamoDB — expensive for a log archive.
